waiver_ids.code_defref_recall_at_5: BE-10-code-defref-gate-above-baseline: floor=1.0 is intentionally above baseline=0.6667. The baseline measures the no-feature calibration run (regenerate.py, no lancedb_root — code-defref ingested through the plain stub pipeline, no DefRefExtractor). The gated test (test_eval_gate_code_defref_recall_at_5) passes lancedb_root, routing code-defref through a real GraphStore + DefRefExtractor + RealGraphExpander wired via _build_code_lane_ingest_pipeline, lifting recall from 0.6667 to 1.0. A regression that disables DefRefExtractor wiring reproduces 0.6667, failing the gate.
waiver_ids.graph_global_recall_at_5: E2e-global-floor-below-stub-baseline: baseline=1.0 was measured via CommunityStoreStub hybrid fallback, not real Leiden community retrieval; real Leiden floor is 0.2 on the 5-query 2WikiMultiHopQA eval set
waiver_ids.graph_negative_control_recall_at_5: E2e-negative-control-nondeterministic: floor=0.34 is conservative regression guard for a non-deterministic metric (observed 0.38-0.43 range due to unseeded store.sample_chunk_texts shuffle); baseline=0.39 reflects a single calibration run
waiver_ids.synonym_bridge_recall_at_5: BE-8-synonym-bridge-gate-above-baseline: floor=0.75 is intentionally above baseline=0.5. The baseline measures plain hybrid recall (stub expander, no synonym edges). The gated test uses RealGraphExpander + synonym_of edges (K8s↔Kubernetes, ML↔machine learning), lifting recall from 0.5 to 1.0. A regression that disables synonym expansion produces 0.5, failing the gate. Floor=0.75 is the discriminating midpoint.
